inlines.v: RET'ICENCE, RET'ICENCY, noun [Latin reticentia, reticeo; re and tacco, to be silent.] Concealment by silence. In rhetoric, aposiopesis or suppression; a figure by which a person really speaks of a thing, while he makes a show as if he would say nothing on the subject.
